description.value: Pholicious is a Vietnamese café on West Pender Street in downtown Vancouver specializing in pho, noodle soups, salad rolls, and bánh mì-style subs. The menu is notably cyclist-friendly in its breadth, offering a dedicated vegetarian and vegan section alongside meat and seafood options. Online ordering with pickup is available, making it a convenient stop for riders passing through the downtown core.
